blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A personal grudge fueled by marital jealousy ended in a deadly shooting Thursday night in Barangay Sawang Calero, leaving a 37-year-old e-bike driver dead and another man in police custody. The incident occurred at around 9:15 p.m. on November 5, 2026, along Tupaz Street, in front of OCS Lending. Responding to a wounded person alarm at 9:25 p.m., officers from Cebu City Police Office Station 6 (PS6), led by Officer-in-Charge Police Major Noah L. Añana, arrived at the scene a minute later.
